newsitem.title: GERMANY: East German growth seen slowing to west levels.
newsitem.headline: East German growth seen slowing to west levels.

text.p: The economic recovery in the former East Germany is still slowing down and could fall to the levels of the more affluent western Germany this year, the economics ministry said on Wednesday.

It said in its monthly economic report that the sharp decline in building activity in the eastern states has not been offset by increased output in other industrial sectors. Growth in the manufacturing sector was particularly moderate.
"The east German economy will therefore probably not grow noticeably faster this year than the west German," the ministry said. "Efforts to catch up (to the west) are therefore beginning to falter."

Echoing statements made recently by Germany's six leading economic research institutes, the ministry said "misguided wage policies" from the days right after unification in 1990 severely damaged the competitiveness of local firms.
As a result, many companies were not able to become profitable and the economic recovery has not become self-sustaining.
